intent: An agent’s commit as a card: the subject, the files it touched, checks that roll from queued to passed, then Open PR.

stack.styling: Tailwind CSS v4 with container queries (@container, @md) and CSS variables (--cmt-*)
stack.animation: motion/react for the entrance and the check-word swap; a CSS spin on the running mark

layout.root: card, max 480px on the stage, 20px radius, overflow hidden, four bands with hairlines
layout.head: 16px padding, 20px from @md. Agent label and hash, subject, one sentence, branch
layout.files: one row per file, path truncates, counts stay on the right
layout.checks: Re-run at the right of the label. Each row is a 14px mark, the name, and the state word
layout.footer: Open PR, full width, 40px, 11px radius, 44px on pointer-coarse
layout.stage: demo only, centred, 12px side padding (32px from sm), top 32px (64px from sm), black or #f4f4f5

color.accent: #f4f4f5 by default, mapped to the theme ink, used only on Open PR. Pass green is only a passed check and an added-line count. The check glyph on the disc is #06210f.

motion.entrance: head, files, checks and the button rise 10px out of a 6px blur over 500ms, delays 40, 120, 200 and 280ms
motion.checks: each check is queued, running, then passed, 320ms a step, the next starting as the previous passes. Six steps, done at 1920ms. Re-run starts them again
motion.word: the state word fades and rises 4px over 200ms
motion.spin: the running mark spins; it does not spin under reduced motion
motion.reducedMotion: 150ms opacity, checks already passed, no spin

responsive.touch: Open PR grows to 44px on pointer-coarse
responsive.overflow: file paths truncate; the subject wraps

accessibility: marks are aria-hidden; the state is the visible word
Re-run and Open PR are buttons; Open PR is disabled until every check has passed, then keeps its weight and reads PR #
a polite live region announces a re-run and an opened pull request after the click
focus-visible is a 2px ink outline, offset 2px

defaults.message: Name when the seat credit lands
defaults.detail: The pricing answer said the credit existed, not when.

content.rules: Open PR does nothing while a check is queued or running. Once opened the button reads PR # and the number.

avoid: an avatar, a GitHub logo, rainbow file icons, a sparkle, or an AI badge
enabling Open PR before every check has passed
using the pass green on the button
a spinner that keeps spinning under reduced motion
